note: Two pull-through gravel sites in full sun, each for up to six people, on the right of Swamp Branch Road 0.2 and 0.3 mile from PA 44. The agency's route from US 220 exit 109 at Mill Hall runs by PA 150, Monument Orviston Road, Falls Road, Beech Creek Road (9.9 miles) and Beech Creek Mountain Road to PA 44 south, then 0.8 mile to Swamp Branch Road on the left. The agency cautions that it is reached by remote dirt or gravel forest roads that may not suit low-clearance vehicles or large RVs. Stone fire rings; no table, toilet or water. Pack out trash. --Claude
summary: Both site pages re-read: SS014 and SS015 still listed, Drive-In, RV/Tent/Trailer categories, max vehicle and equipment length 25 ft, pull-through gravel driveways 120 ft; count 2, 25 ft and pull_through confirmed, a sites note added.
